cohort: 910 primiparous women in Denmark who had a singleton live birth between 2007 and 2012
finding: The study found that the association between cesarean delivery and subsequent fecundability varied depending on previous fetal presentation and whether the cesarean was planned or unplanned, with planned cesarean delivery and cesarean delivery with breech presentation being associated with reduced fecundability.
mod_finding: The type of cesarean delivery (planned or unplanned, fetal presentation) had varying associations with fecundability.
